LESSON: STORIES OF PROPHETS:

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: PILLARS OF IMAN
Topic 3.1: Stories of Prophets:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Stories of Prophets:
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How did the selected prophets demonstrate Iman in Allah (S.W.T.)?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development
2. appreciate the selected prophets as role models

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the selected prophets as role models

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the selected prophets as role models.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the selected prophets as role models” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the selected prophets as role models” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the selected prophets as role models" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development
• Model 2: appreciate the selected prophets as role models

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development
2. Practise: appreciate the selected prophets as role models

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Stories of Prophets:.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did the selected prophets demonstrate Iman in Allah (S.W.T.)?
2. What virtues are derived from prophets Ibrahim (A.S.) and Musa (A.S.)’s stories?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development
• appreciate the selected prophets as role models

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
